messages:
Maya (partnerships): VeloxChip just sent an EAP kit + NDA link. They want a short validation run focused on marketplace readiness and SI integration checklist. Also asked about joint announcement window (they suggested 3 weeks).
Carlos (bench): Sounds good. Can we agree on a minimal benchmark set: throughput (1/2/4 batch), p50/p95 latency, cold vs warm KV cache, and an embedding run? Need candidate prompt set — I'll paste a ~20-prompt list to the NDA folder.
Priya (legal): NDA note: we can run internal benchmarks and summarize anonymized results. Any public claim about % improvement needs legal sign-off and a joint quote clause. Also: do not re-host Velox private firmware outside NDA bucket.
Dmitri (eng-runtime): heads up: their driver requires a small kernel module patch for our runtime to expose hw-accelerated attention paths. Patch looks small but we should pin the driver version used for bench. Config snippet I'll use to load driver:
```
# load velox module with options
modprobe velox_chip debug=0 fastpath=1
# runtime env
VELOX_DRIVER=/opt/velox/velox-1.2.3.ko
```
Velox Eng: thanks. We'll provide signed module and symbol files. For SI teams we can also share a short runbook (slides + checklist) under NDA. We cannot allow screenshots of firmware output in public docs.
Carlos (bench): infra-bot, request 3 nodes (velox:eap) with 48GB each, k8s label velox:eap and taint velox-only=true. Terraform tag: eap-velox-mar2026.
infra-bot: Request accepted; provisioning 3 nodes -> k8s-eap-velox-pool-7. ETA ~10m.
Maya (partnerships): timeline proposal: day 0: baseline runs (no extra telemetry). day 1: enable verbose telemetry + SI run. day 3: internal sync with Velox to go over anomalies. day 7: partner gets sanitized summary for joint messaging approval. Does that work?
Priya (legal): timeline fine. Send sanitized summary to legal-velox@redwood with the NDA reference for sign-off before any external comms.
Dmitri (eng-runtime): note: if we enable verbose telemetry there's a perf delta (expect ~5-7% cost). We'll do baseline then short verbose window. Also adding a watchdog to kill runaway kernels.
Velox Eng: perfect. We'll attend the day 3 sync and provide SI contact list. If you hit reproducible crashes please upload oops and a minimal repro to the NDA bucket and we'll triage.
Maya (partnerships): I'll set up the calendar invite and include sales (marketplace), solutions (si-team), and docs. Putting the NDA link and S3 path in the invite.
Carlos (bench): starting baseline run in 5. Will post sanitized metric summary here when done.
